reminder: [relay] The main session only orchestrates: anything that needs a tool (read, search, run, write, web, MCP) goes to a subagent, using the delegation table from session start. A question that needs no tool: answer it directly.
denied: sync_relay: the main session only orchestrates and this tool is work. Delegate it to a subagent (Claude: Agent; Codex: spawn_agent) using the delegation table.
handoff_request: [handoff] The user asked for a session handoff. If a subagent has not reported back yet, do not write yet: tell the user you will write it when it does, then do it. Write it to {file} (Markdown, at most {max} characters, in the user's language; create the folder if missing). {how} Contents, in this order: 1) the user's request, in their words; 2) state: done (with the evidence), in progress, missing; 3) decisions taken and why, including the user's; 4) where everything is: files, branches, PRs, worktrees, work folders, processes; 5) what does not carry over by itself, if any: the active goal, its condition word for word (/clear drops it; the user sets it again with /goal); each scheduled task from CronList (id, schedule, prompt; /clear keeps it, so check CronList before creating it again); each background command or agent still running (id, what it does, output file; its notice will reach the new session); 6) numbered next steps, the first one runnable now; 7) risks and unchecked assumptions. Do not copy rules that already live in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md. Do not include answers already given or tool tips: that is memory, not task state. When done, reply only: handoff ready (Claude: /clear; Codex: /new).
handoff_how_claude: Write it yourself with the Write tool at exactly that path (the lock allows only that path); do not delegate.
handoff_how_codex: Delegate the write to a subagent that inherits this context (spawn_agent with fork_context).
handoff_injected: [handoff] This session continues a previous one. Handoff ({file}):
handoff_cut: [handoff cut] Full text in file {file} (the main session does not read files: ask a subagent to read it).
stop_warning: Context at {total}k tokens (+{extra}k above the start of this session): past the switch point ({limit}k). Type relay (or /relay on Claude Code). Then start a new session (Claude: /clear; Codex: /new): it starts with the handoff.
report_too_long: Your report is over {max} characters. Send it again within {max}: what you did, the decision, the evidence, what is left. Put long detail in a file and give only its path.
detect_failed: sync_relay: lock off. Could not tell whether this session is interactive (the CLI did not expose the signal), so no tool is blocked. Set SYNC_RELAY_MODE=force to force the lock.
handoff_dir_unusable: sync_relay: could not create the handoff folder (the configured one and the default are both unusable), so the handoff was not requested. Set "handoff_dir" to a writable absolute path in the config file.
routing_cut: [routing table cut] It did not fit with the handoff in the context limit.
mode_off: sync_relay: lock OFF for this session (no reminder either). `relay on` brings it back.
mode_remind: sync_relay: reminder only for this session (nothing is blocked). `relay on` brings the lock back.
mode_on: sync_relay: lock ON for this session.
mode_ack: [relay] The user changed the lock mode for this session. Nothing to do: reply only "ok".
mode_failed: sync_relay: could not save the mode for this session (no usable state folder or session id); nothing changed. Set "mode" in the config file or SYNC_RELAY_MODE.
repo_released: sync_relay: {file} lets the main session run: {pats}
alias_warn: sync_relay: the variable(s) {names} still work, but they go away in 0.4.0. Use the SYNC_RELAY_* name instead.
sub_wait: {n} background task(s) of this session are still running (Claude Code sends every Bash over about 180 s to the background). Do not return a partial result: wait for the end notice and only then send your final report.
long_command: - long command: Claude Code sends every Bash over ~180 s to the background; wait for the end notice and return the final result, never only a partial one.
lock_hint: sync_relay: lock ON. To turn it off for THIS session only, type `/relay off` (or just `relay off` without the mod, or in Codex); `relay remind` keeps only the reminder, `relay on` brings the lock back. The lock keeps the model on task; it is not a sandbox.
pattern_ignored: sync_relay: pattern(s) ignored, the first word must be literal (no `*`, `?`, `[`): {pats}
